digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP tool search configuration
propositions: Serena symbol tool schemas are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating discovery-step friction compared to always-loaded tools like Bash
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only global control for tool deferral; no per-tool or per-server lever exists to selectively keep Serena tools resident without loading all connected MCP servers' schemas

A repo-committed .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false loaded all four servers' schemas at 63,852 additional tokens (~2.7x cost); Serena-only measurement showed 25,454 token floor cost for this goal
The .claude/ directory is git-ignored, requiring a .gitignore negation to track only .claude/settings.json while keeping operator-local files and worktree configs unaffected

The tradeoff is measurable and global: enabling always-loaded schemas prevents symbol tool discovery friction at the cost of increased context window usage per session, with dominance from non-Serena MCP servers
